title: Multi-Term Fourier Graph Neural Network with Sample Relationship Learning for Enhanced Remaining Useful Life Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2609.25179v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Predicting the remaining useful life (RUL) is essential for effective predictive maintenance. Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Networks (ST-GNNs), which can model both temporal and spatial relationships by representing time series data as a sequence of graphs, have shown exceptional performance in RUL prediction. However, current ST-GNNs face several drawbacks. First, they require domain expertise or significant computational power to establish graph structures prior to deploying GNNs. Second, the models are restricted to capture temporal dependencies within a predefined fixed-size lookback window. This restriction ignores the common issue of varying time series lengths, leading the prediction model to miss short-term or long-term dependencies. translated_title: 结合样本关系学习的多项傅里叶图神经网络用于增强剩余使用寿命预测
translated_abstract: 预测剩余使用寿命（RUL）对于实现有效的预测性维护至关重要。时空图神经网络（ST-GNNs）通过将时间序列数据表示为图序列，能够同时建模时间关系和空间关系，在RUL预测中展现出了卓越的性能。然而，当前的ST-GNNs存在若干缺陷。首先，它们需要领域专业知识或大量计算能力才能在部署GNN之前建立图结构。其次，这些模型被限制在预定义的固定大小回看窗口内捕获时间依赖性。这一限制忽略了时间序列长度各不相同这一常见问题，导致预测模型遗漏短期或长期依赖关系。最后，传统模型往往无法捕获由相邻时间窗口生成的样本之间的内在关系，而这些关系对于提升预测的准确性和鲁棒性至关重要。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种结合样本关系学习的多项傅里叶图神经网络，克服了现有时空图神经网络在图结构构建依赖专业知识、固定回看窗口限制以及忽略相邻时间窗口样本间关系方面的不足，从而提升了剩余使用寿命预测的准确性与鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a Multi-Term Fourier Graph Neural Network with sample relationship learning, which overcomes the limitations of existing ST-GNNs—namely the need for expertise to build graph structures, fixed-size lookback windows, and neglected relationships between samples from adjacent time windows—thereby enhancing the accuracy and robustness of remaining useful life prediction.
